scientific_question: Across 1024, 2048, 4096, and 8192 training samples, does unchanged raw dynamic-medial M7-XR sharpen useful longitudinal structure on both locked PHerc0139 and blind PHerc1447 without violating the anti-blob rule?

single_axis.rule: Start from released M7 once and change only cumulative training duration. Dynamic-medial weight 0.03125, corpus, deterministic sample order, objective, optimizer, constant learning rate, batch, accumulation, trust radius, validation cadence, threshold evaluation, and raw no-blend inference remain fixed.

candidate.label: dynconn_w0p03125_n8192_duration
candidate.hypothesis: Two complete deterministic corpus passes test whether additional exposure and repetition recover faint longitudinal strips and hard de-blobbed structure before changing the medial formulation or its weight.

evaluation.heldout_pherc1447: all six cubes and all standard fixed views for every milestone
